run_relax_job: run a geometry optimization job on an ASE Atoms structure and return initial and final energy and forces
run_single_point_job: run a single-point energy and force calculation on an ASE Atoms structure using any ASE calculator
run_conformers: run geometry optimizations on molecular conformers organized by molecule family and return optimized structures and energies
run_protonation: run protonation state energy and geometry calculations for molecules across different protonation states
run_spin_gap: run single-point calculations on structures at different spin states to evaluate spin gap energies
